core_meaning.primary_meaning: Forouzan is a Persian-origin name meaning “Shining, radiant”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Forouzan corresponds to the Persian form فروزاں (Persian فروزان (forūzān) 'shining, radiant'). Its core sense is radiant, blooming. Forouzan is the Persian feminine name فروزان (Forūzān) 'shining, radiant, luminous', the present participle of فروختن/فروزیدن 'to shine'. Its relationship to فیروز (Fīrūz) is real but the two are distinct forms. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave علی (Ali) as the Arabic form of forouzan — a different name — which has been removed. The source gloss 'victory, triumph' is not the lexical sense.
